Hello,

I would like to buy the Hammer Miner DC06 (330MH/s), Final Sale, price $379.99 (Please confirm the compatibility with France power supply/plug).

From France, the product page shows it as out of stock for the EU warehouse ("We cannot estimate the shipping date at this time"), and the "Notify me when Live" button does not seem to work for me. However, the page also says that 54 of 66 units are still available worldwide and that I can contact support to ship from another warehouse.

Could you please:
1. Confirm that you can ship one unit from your US or Canada warehouse to France;
2. Give me the total delivered cost (shipping, import duties/VAT and any extra fees) and the estimated delivery time;
3. Tell me how to place the order (payment link, or a way to reserve the unit).
4. Is it possible to pay with Paypal in installments (x4, x10, x12) ?

I am ready to order as soon as I have these details.

Thank you,
Arnaud
Read the hammer miner scrypt dc06 330 mh s page
Handed to the team · Cross-region shipping to France and PayPal installment availability are not mine
